title: Achieving excellent strength-ductility balance in the lightweight refractory high-entropy alloy by incorporating aluminum
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting and solidified in a copper crucible with recirculating cooling water. The ingots were flipped 8 times to ensure uniform distribution of high-melting-point Ta metal. A Ti ingot was used to absorb residual oxygen before melting. The button-shaped alloy was suction-cast into plate dimensions of 12×8×80 mm³.
